name: INMP441 I2S MEMS microphone breakout
blurb: An I2S digital microphone. This legacy record provides logical pin names only: its single-row physical model is unsupported. Resolve the exact seller board before physical wiring drawings, a case or a carrier PCB.

pins.name: SCK
pins.note: Bit clock from the controller. Inputs must also stay at or below VDD + 0.3 V and 3.63 V (absolute limits); the simple validator does not enforce this supply-relative limit.

pins.name: WS
pins.note: Word select (left/right clock) from the controller. Inputs must also stay at or below VDD + 0.3 V and 3.63 V (absolute limits); the simple validator does not enforce this supply-relative limit.

pins.name: SD
pins.note: Audio data out. It goes high-impedance on the channel the mic does not occupy, so two mics can share it.

pins.name: L/R
pins.note: Channel select. GND = left, 3.3 V = right. Do not leave it floating. Inputs must also stay at or below VDD + 0.3 V and 3.63 V (absolute limits); the simple validator does not enforce this supply-relative limit.

pins.name: VDD
pins.note: Use a 3.3 V rail. TDK Rev1.1 Table6 describes VDD as 1.8–3.3 V; Table1 gives 1.62–3.63 V electrical limits. Never connect to 5 V. Current is specified for the chip, not additional module components.

verify: PHYSICAL GEOMETRY UNRESOLVED. The retained 14×14 mm, single-row pad coordinates, PCB thickness, header height and acoustic opening are legacy model assumptions, not measured or source-supported geometry. Reviewed Elkim, Fibel and HusHageHobby photographs show two rows of three terminals; Fibel/HusHageHobby are round/notched boards, not this square single-row model. Elkim states approximately 10×10 mm PCB; HusHageHobby has a general 14×14×3 mm Dimensions field with unresolved physical scope. These are separate seller claims, not two proven standardized variants. No numeric module pad positions were found. See assets/geometry-evidence/variant-records.json. Electrical values now cite the opened TDK/InvenSense DS-INMP441-00 Rev1.1: at3.3V normal-mode chip current is2.2mA typical,2.5mA maximum; the former1.4/1.6mA figures apply at1.8V. Table6 recommends1.8–3.3V, Table1 gives1.62–3.63V electrical limits. Chip-level bottom-port/package drawings do not establish the board sound-hole side or coordinates. Exact chip authenticity and any additional module circuitry remain unverified.
